# Persona conflicts with task (PRG002)

An assigned persona that conflicts with the task.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `prag-persona-conflict` |
| Family | pragmatic |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | prac |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

The assigned persona pulls against what the task needs.

Bad:  You are terse. Now write a full tutorial with worked examples.
Good: Write a full tutorial with worked examples.

Not a finding when persona and task agree.
